title: Infernal Field
summary: “The souls of the damned burn on...”

sections.heading: Where it appears
lines: Natural battles in Soul Sand Valley.

sections.heading: Type power
lines: Fire moves and dark moves are 1.5× stronger.
Special fairy moves and water moves are halved (0.5×).
Aura Sphere, Frustration, and Spirit Break also count as Dark for type matchups.
Ground moves also count as Fire for type matchups.
Steel moves also count as Fire for type matchups.
Rock moves also count as Fire for type matchups.

sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Dream Eater, Punishment, and Smog: 2× stronger.
Blast Burn, Infernal Parade, Inferno, Inferno Overdrive, Precipice Blades, and Raging Fury: 1.5× stronger.
Dark Void, Inferno, and Will-O-Wisp: never miss.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Fire-type.
Nature Power becomes Punishment.
Secret Power can cause burn.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Glaciate changes the field into Dimensional.
Judgment, Origin Pulse, and Purify change the field into Volcanic Top.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Blaze: 1.5× power for Fire-type moves.
Desolate Land, Flame Body, or Magma Armor: Defense +1 and Special Defense +1 when it enters.
Fire Mane: 2× power for Fire-type moves.

sections.heading: Each turn
lines: Soul Eater restores 1/16 of its HP.
Steam Engine: Speed +1.

Each turn, grounded Pokémon that are not Fire-type (not those using Aqua Ring, Dig, or Dive) without Flame Body, Flare Boost, Flash Fire, Heatproof, Magic Guard, Magma Armor, Water Bubble, Water Veil, or Well-Baked Body lose 1/8 of their maximum HP (burned by the field).

sections.heading: Weather and status
lines: Hail cannot be started here.
Rain cannot be started here.
Snow cannot be started here.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Elemental Seed: Attack +1, Special Attack +1, and is trapped.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
